title: Public Provident Fund - statutory scheme and account offices
text: The Public Provident Fund scheme is a statutory scheme of the Central Government framed under the provisions of the Public Provident Act, 1968. The approved branches of HDFC Bank Limited have been designated as accounts offices under the scheme. A year for the purpose of this scheme means the financial year ending 31st March.

title: Public Provident Fund - subscription amount and frequency
text: You can subscribe any amount in multiples of Rs 5/- between Rs 500/- and Rs 1,50,000/- in a year to your public provident fund account. It is not necessary that you should subscribe every month of the year. You can vary the amount of subscription to suit your convenience. Maximum of 12 subscriptions are allowed in a year.

title: Public Provident Fund - first loan eligibility
text: The account entitles you to obtain a loan. If you require it you can apply for your first loan in the third year from the year of opening your account i.e. if you have opened your account in 2016-17, you can apply for your first loan in 2018-19.

title: Public Provident Fund - first loan amount and repayment
text: You are entitled to receive 25% of the balance to your credit on 31-03-2017 by way of loan, repayable in 36 months in convenient monthly installments.

title: Public Provident Fund - subsequent loans
text: You can get further loans upto the end of the fifth year following the expiry of the year in which the initial subscription was made. But no second loan can be taken so long as the first loan has not been fully repaid and the amount of any fresh loan will be restricted to 25% of the balance at credit at the end of the second year immediately preceding the year in which the loan is applied for.

title: Public Provident Fund - no loan after fifth year
text: No loan can be taken after the end of the fifth year as indicated above.

title: Public Provident Fund - partial withdrawal facility
text: Some limited facilities for final withdrawals without closing the account have also been provided. The withdrawal will be restricted to 50 per cent of the amount at credit at the end of the sixth year immediately preceding the year in which the amount is withdrawn.

title: Public Provident Fund - first partial withdrawal timing
text: For example, this partial withdrawal can be made for the first time on 01-04-2022 so as to get 50% of the balance to your credit on 31-03-2017.

title: Public Provident Fund - subsequent partial withdrawals at three year intervals
text: Similar withdrawals can also be made subsequently at three year intervals but the amount which can be withdrawn will be restricted to 50% of the amount standing to your credit at the end of the sixth year, immediately preceding the year in which the withdrawal is made.

title: Public Provident Fund - complete withdrawal after 15 years
text: The Public Provident Fund Scheme allows you to withdraw the entire amounts to your credit after adjustment of the dues if any to Government on completion of 15 years after the end of the year in which you opened your account. That is to say if you opened your account in 2016-17, you can withdraw the entire balances to your credit any time after 01-04-2032.

title: Public Provident Fund - optional withdrawal and continuation
text: This is, of course optional. You can continue your account without any loss of benefits.

title: Public Provident Fund - tax deduction on subscription
text: As per existing provisions subscription to the Public Provident Fund qualify for deduction from taxable income together with savings in other approved form namely, recognized Provident Funds, Life Insurance, etc.

title: Public Provident Fund - tax exemption on interest and balance
text: The interest credited to the fund and the amount standing to the credit of the subscribers are exempt from Income Tax and Wealth Tax respectively.

title: Public Provident Fund - nomination facility
text: You are entitled to nominate one or more person to receive any final payment, which is due to you, in the event of your death. The facility of nomination is one that should be availed of by you, as your heirs may otherwise be put to the avoidable inconvenience of producing succession certificates to establish their claims to the amount due to them.

title: Public Provident Fund - no trust as nominee
text: A subscriber to the fund cannot nominate a trust as his nominee.

title: Public Provident Fund - revival of discontinued account
text: Revival of discontinued account - Depositors seeking condonation of the default in making minimum subscription of Rs 500/- per annum can revive their PPF account by payment of a fee of Rs 50/- for each year of default along-with arrears of subscription of Rs 500/- for each default/financial year.

title: Public Provident Fund - general grounds for premature closure not entertained
text: Request for Premature closure of accounts. The Branches will not entertain any request for premature closure of PPF account under the noted grounds: (a) Migration abroad (b) Marriage (c) Purchase of house/vehicle (d) Ceremonial occasions (e) Repayment of loan (f) Education (g) Retiring, suspension from job, etc.

title: Public Provident Fund - extreme compassionate grounds for premature closure
text: Only those cases falling under extreme compassionate ground such as medial support in life threatening diseases cases, death cases, etc. deserve consideration for granting closure and will be entertained.

title: Public Provident Fund - operation by Power of Attorney holder not allowed
text: Operation by a Power of Attorney Holder - In the absence of a specific provision in the Public Provident Fund Scheme 1968, a power of Attorney Holder can neither open a PPF account nor operate any PPF account on behalf of a subscriber.

title: Public Provident Fund - NRI not eligible to open account
text: Non Resident Indians - NRIs are not eligible to open an account under the PPF Scheme. Provided that if a resident who subsequently becomes NRI during the currency of maturity period prescribed under PPF Scheme, may continue to subscribe to the Fund till its maturity on a non-repatriation basis.

title: Public Provident Fund - address change communication
text: It is important and will be desirable in your own interest to ensure that changes in your address are communicated promptly to the accounts office.

title: Public Provident Fund - online account default branch
text: For PPF account opened online, the default branch is maintained as Anna Nagar. However, the account can be operated from any branch.

title: Public Provident Fund - deposit post 11 PM value date
text: Please note, if any deposit in PPF account is done post 11:00 PM, then value date of next day will reflect in the system.
